traces.title: Already-stocked material -> ordinary sword -> source-sensitive combat artifact
prerequisites: A Smithing station with a workspace, fuel and reachable resources; sword recipe admits MetalBlock, RockBlock or WoodBlock as main material.
Ordinary refining UI requires a player Dao disciple able to do magic/disciple handwork, not rented/visitor/attacker or job banned; reachable Refining station and free selected object.
UI selection rejects current FightFabao/TreasureFabao/Esoterica inputs, requires free count and Ling >= item.Rate^2 * 500. BehaviourRefiningFabao separately requires normal health.
decisions: Choose sword as the station product and its actual main material. This traces already-stocked ingots, not mining or smelting.
Choose ordinary object refining, pick the owned/free sword, and choose the character doing it. Keeping the sword ordinary is a viable alternative; secret recipe and Helian branches are distinct.
Choose preparation through current character Manual skill, mind-state/property bonuses and building quality before committing; the source ties those values to actual outcomes.
expenditures: Sword data declares main material volume5, one Item_RoughWoodBlock and100 Item_Water, nominal600work. Actual main-material count uses ceil(CostStuffCount*CostStuffScale) then ceil(material multiplier*that count); fixed items use their separate rcount=ceil(count*countscale) unless noscale. Iron declares multiplier1, but live difficulty scaling is not frozen.

BuildingProduce locks actual ingredients, debits them only on the first nonzero work addition, accumulates their Ling/material provenance, and then advances paid work. Station Drive adds a separate fuel requirement; exact fuel cadence was not traced.

Ordinary refining type0 debits item.Rate^2*500 Ling when its toil enters. One input object is debited on completed success or completed random failure; an interrupted ordinary refining toil also consumes one input.
state_changes: Smithing completes into one sword with actual StuffDef, quality/element and input provenance; no mere recipe flag supplies it.

Ordinary refine success constructs a new FightFaBao, retains source material/element and object provenance, computes artifact rank from source rank and inherited Ling, then sets name, author and need-click; source object loses one count.

Success adds school Fabao count, rank-squared TreeExp, stories/events; random failure gives30TreeExp, failure story/message and failure event with no output. Interruption alters obsession mind value and reports failure.
downstream_consumers: ItemThing.InitFabao -> FabaoData.Init parses both main-material and source-object physical labels plus element into PS values. Sharp data adds AttackPower/FlySpeed/RotSpeed; Hard2 trades power against Ling recovery/capacity/rotation and knockback.

XiaWorld.Fight.FabaoBase.Init binds FromItem; GetPower reads that actual item Fabao AttackPower, owner modifiers and current powerup; GetAtkPower uses GetPower. FightBody.FB_BeHit calls GetAtkPower and passes the value, owner and artifact element to BindThing.ReduceDamage. The manufactured object therefore has a real damage consumer.
time_policy: Ordinary artifact toil target: min((80*input.Rate + input.LingV/100)/(1 + 0.02*Manual + speed bonus),300) world-time units; QuickWork overrides40. Progress follows unit.keeptime. These are simulation-time values, not measured wall-clock durations.

Smithing advances work by dt*work efficiency*SmithingSpeed*building FengShui efficiency; generic manufacturing can yield to a higher priority job after48time units, checked on5-unit world-time cadence.
This object-refining command is a finite actor job; formula-based production uses a separate queue.
failure_and_aftermath: Selection has explicit no-energy/no-free-object rejection without a source mutation; unavailable path/workspace prevents discovery.

Toil random success uses 0.6 -0.4*input.Rate +0.1*Manual +mind-state map +success property, with special success/failure overrides. UI displays clamped probability except RealMode conceals it. No measured success rate claimed.

Random failure consumes the valuable chosen object and energy but preserves a smaller TreeExp trace. Cancellation/interruption type0 also destroys one object once toil is entered. Pre-toil cancellation cleanup unlocks it; exact every JobEngine interruption boundary not audited.
Smithing may injure the actor on leave according to SmithingInjuredChance. Exact injury content not traced.
limits: No selected live manufacture/refine/combat session, balancing measurement or personal save inspection.
Mining/smelting, fuel driver cadence, all inherited XML merge rules, every material effect and full combat hit/AI behavior are outside coverage.
Secret FabaoFormula creation, Helian sacrifice and God artifacts were read only as contextual branches; not folded into ordinary recipe facts.

traces.title: NoHunger1 batch -> consumed medicine -> less food/rest interruption; JingYuan contrast
prerequisites: Dao disciple eligible for magic/treatment work; RefiningDan station and empty usable queue; formula either Normal>0 or actually learned.

NoHunger1 is Normal1, Medicine level5, base success addition0.8, base Count9; item Rate6 causes entry energy debit200. Its XML declares3Fruit+9Ginkgo+9Healroot and200nominalwork; actual fixed-item request/debit uses rcount with its current countscale.
Actual ingredients must reach the building bag; reachable workspace and fuel required. CommandMakeItem only allows the exact Maker selected in the recipe queue.
decisions: Choose NoHunger1 rather than JingYuan or another medicine, select current maker and station.
Station element relation and FengShui, maker Medicine-derived properties, yield/speed bonuses and runtime difficulty modifiers change actual batch success/count/time.
Consume the output before extended work, retain/sell it, or use ordinary food/rest. JingYuan instead buys faster practice-resource conversion with increased nutrition use.
expenditures: UILogicMode queues exact Maker/Param/output/base Count. BuildingProduce waits for all actual stock and locks it; first Making call consumes reserved ingredients.
ToilMakeItem.OnEnter deducts200*max(1,output.Rate-5)^3 Ling; NoHunger1 Rate6 gives200 independent of batch success.
ToilEatItem spends a timed consumption action, locks one actual pill and SubCount(1) only after completed EatItem returns true.
state_changes: Work completion removes current queue task before rolling, may enqueue next loop, and returns success1 or failure-1. Success yields max(1,floor(9*adjustedYield)) actual authored output count, copied manufacture provenance, school Danyao count, TreeExp, elixir gas callback for player production and actual item events.

Completed failure spends already-debited ingredients/energy, creates one randomly selected failed-pill type with World.RandomRange(1,6) count, gives50TreeExp, obsession/failure story/message/event. The exact upper bound of random count is not asserted without RandomRange implementation.
Normal eligible EatItem applies Dan_NoHunger1 modifier. It declares MaxStack1, Duration1200 and NutritionConsumeConstant/FatigueConsumeConstant AddP-0.5, as well as Food Nutrition50.
JingYuan declares modifier Duration4200, NutritionConsumeConstant AddP1 and NutritionToJingYuanK AddV0.005; its formula level0/base0.9/count1 and25MagicHerb+9LingStone/200work differ from NoHunger1.
downstream_consumers: Npc.NormalEatItem adds declared nutrition to FoodNeed. FoodNeed.GetSubValue multiplies hunger loss by NutritionConsumeConstant; RestNeed.GetSubValue multiplies awake fatigue loss by FatigueConsumeConstant.
FoodNeed extreme hunger and RestNeed severe fatigue can interrupt ordinary jobs, so these pill modifiers affect continued useful labor.
FoodNeed.OnValueChange converts lost food increments into Practice need using NutritionToJingYuanK for disciples; JingYuan trades more food use for that actual conversion consumer.
time_policy: Work advances with dt, current work efficiency, DanMake speed and building FengShui; nominal200 is work, not200real seconds.

Born station relation adds0.2success and multiplies yield1.5; Contrary subtracts0.2 and halves yield; Same adds0.1 and multiplies1.2. Runtime RefineDanFailRate caps success and RefineDanProduceScale adjusts yield.

Current task value/progress live with the building and are serialized with queue; higher-priority work may interrupt the actor without removing accumulated task value. Entry energy is paid again whenever a new ToilMakeItem enters; exact resumed/reload cost behavior remains a live acceptance query.
Loop=-1 or Loop>1 enqueues a replacement on completion before success/failure; each loop requires new ingredients and a maker. No free output from defining a loop.

ModifierBase checks TolSecond-AddTimes against Duration; same-scale reapplication refreshes time through NpcPropertyMgr. Duration1200 is two days in source description; inspected code establishes1200world-time units, not a measured user session.
failure_and_aftermath: Missing ingredient/path/fuel/workspace/maker has a waiting/rejection path before actual craft; it is not a failed paid batch.
Post-start random failure creates failed pills, exp/obsession and events rather than resetting stock. Failed-pill uses/effects were not traced.
Body-cultivation or lingering eligibility can prevent the shared elixir modifier branch; normal food still has its own route. No universal potion effect across body types claimed.
Generic per-item ElixirFesistance is updated in EatItem. ElixirData default multiplier1 means these selected pills do not establish diminishing efficacy; other medicines may explicitly set it.
limits: No full medicine catalogue, failed-pill consumer, elixir-gas system, alternative-race eating branch or medicine acquisition/learn source audit.
Live generated inputs, UI balance, ingestion safety/balance, exact difficulty values and save/reload interruption behavior remain unobserved.

adaptation.title: Dress scraped palms with an actual existing balm, then resume useful hand work
adaptation.source_reason: ACS ties consumed pills to actual needs/work consumers and a world-time lifetime. Adapt a specific character condition consequence instead of copying colony stations or adding a generic artifact/material framework.
player_journey: Earn/unlock and craft, buy or already own one existing Healing balm through native owners; no research packet grants stock or recipe unlock.
When actual SCRAPED_HANDS is active in the Village/Shack, review one-minute dressing with one actual balm versus current three-minute body.recover without a balm.

Accepted dressing reserves the real native item, current living body/location/usable-hand support and current shared clock. Completion consumes one balm, applies its existing native Weak healing balm semantics, removes only SCRAPED_HANDS and records treatment/means.

Resume existing packing or eligible kit work. If SORE_HANDS remains, the tenderness penalty/block remains. Learned grip, calluses/marks, prior injury knowledge, inventory and named outcomes stay retained.

prepareGameplayPublication/readGameplayActor currently stage inventory/skills/reputation, not native active_effects. Main persistExpansion already supports staged nativePublication, and persistExpansionPlan supports nativePatch/nativePublication in the one validated envelope. Existing effectDurations only adjusts already-present effects. Missing piece is a staged validated new/reapplied balm-effect adapter in these existing paths, coupled with balm debit and body-condition removal; no second publisher.

Current bodyFacts and packing gates already consume tenderness. New command/facts/receipt and supported optional save admission need current host registration; do not change legacy body.recover revision or existing native use_item semantics automatically.
proposed_cost_result: Proposal:1owned Healing balm+1played minute; recipe costs and the90-duration native effect remain whatever current native owner admits. No new item required.

Result removes only actual scraped-palms condition and preserves native medicine-use effect policy. No added full stamina recovery, soreness removal, mastery/XP beyond existing native medicine-use behavior, permanent body reset or regional reputation.

Retained consequence:spent balm and prior scrape/treatment observation; hand condition settles, other body conditions and marks remain. Native medicine effect expiration remains owned by its current system.
failure_compatibility: If no genuine scrape/stock/body support, preview blocks without consuming. Cancel or lose supported completion before treatment:refund reserved balm and no condition/HP change. Successful treatment cannot be replayed from receipt to recreate stock.

Keep old saves and undeclared packet state inert. Optional new enrollment/receipt must preserve current schema5-11 and frozen jobs per integrator policy; exact admission revision left to sole integrator.

Freeze native active-effect and simulation condition states in the same validated save transaction. Preserve both native-effect lifetime semantics and current shared clock; no replacement hunger timer, inventory, scheduler or save publisher.

Avoid consuming medicine solely for an already-active native effect rejected by add_active_effect; contextual scrape treatment is its own disclosed useful result, so one debit must be tied to actual condition change.
ownership: Shared integrator01a10fe7 owns any runtime/native/UI/save registration; artifact GM retains artifact_collection/workshop until release. This research writer changes none of those files.
GD-01 material evidence and GD-02 site transformation are separate ready discovery proposals. This packet adds a medicine-to-body/work consumer and does not duplicate them.
later_playable_gate: On a generated private test origin with rebuilt changed source:earn a balm by current recipe/stock, incur actual scraped palms, compare rest/dressing, commit and observe one real item debit plus native healing effect and exact hand-condition removal; packing duration/work eligibility changes only when no other tenderness remains.

Cancel and stale/lost-support cases preserve stock/conditions; failed save publishes neither debit nor HP/condition change; reload/import retains the paid result and independent native effect lifetime without duplicated medicine, new mastery or grants.
Original opening and one-realm/one-prestige remain intact. Gameplay/unit/browser/save-failure/regression/director suites are currently deferred; proposal is not implemented, and no gate was run here.
design_limits: High recipe cost versus three-minute rest makes dressing mainly useful for already-owned medicine or urgent work. Numeric advantage and fiction are provisional director choices, not ACS balance copied wholesale.
No claim of pharmacology or medical realism; this is original game behavior around existing fictional items.
Existing Vela loose/paired artifact functions already supply kit-time alternatives; their source is a reuse owner, not a requested ACS remake.
